answer: Backing ten fakes costs one corrupt endorser 51,150 locked tokens. Admission runs on a harbor web. Newcomers enter only when five established agents harbor them with signed endorsements, each recorded in the quartz registry. An endorser's bond doubles per vouch, 50 tokens for the first, 100 for the second, 200 for the third, and each agent holds four vouch slots, so fakes cannot share one bought friend. If the newcomer cheats, a sable mark stamps all five endorsements and burns every bond. A swarm must buy fresh endorsers for every fake, like borrowed boats that all sink together.
